contract: Magento / Adobe Commerce V1 Product Field Matrix

rows.external_read_contract: Stock product GET may expose id; entity-bound Safe Sync trusted read returns verified logical id.
rows.external_write_contract: Not a writable Product save field.
rows.platform_representation: Trusted account-scoped ExternalRecordLink discriminator and exact expected SKU precondition.
rows.connector_read_seam: AdobeSafeSyncClient::readProduct() remains the trusted read seam; stock GET is read-only candidate evidence only.
rows.result_or_blocker: Stock GET must not replace trusted identity authority after link trust is established.

rows.external_read_contract: Stock product GET exposes sku; Safe Sync trusted read uses exact expected SKU precondition.
rows.external_write_contract: Magento stock POST and PUT are SKU-addressed at the REST surface.
rows.platform_representation: ProductVariant sku plus trusted external identity link.
rows.connector_read_seam: Stock GET and Safe Sync trusted read precondition.
rows.connector_write_seam: No trusted SKU mutation seam; Safe Sync keeps expected_sku as precondition only.
rows.result_or_blocker: No trusted consequential SKU-addressed write may become the approved write path; public Live remains false.

rows.external_read_contract: Stock product GET and Safe Sync trusted read expose name.
rows.external_write_contract: Magento stock save and Safe Sync simple write allow name mutation.
rows.platform_representation: Governed Product.name column and trusted receive proposal output.
rows.connector_read_seam: AdobeProductReceiveProposalService uses trusted ERL plus Safe Sync read to build name proposal.
rows.connector_write_seam: Existing AdobeSafeSyncClient::writeSimpleProduct() is the approved future trusted write seam.
rows.result_or_blocker: Trusted READ and name proposal already exist; trusted WRITE consumption is still pending executor rewiring.

rows.external_write_contract: Type is effectively set by product creation path, not a current trusted mutation target.
rows.platform_domain_owner: Product family and connector execution planning
rows.platform_representation: Runtime classifier for simple versus configurable behavior.
rows.connector_read_seam: Stock GET only on current base.
rows.result_or_blocker: A reusable full product document reader is still missing on current base.

rows.external_write_contract: Magento stock save and Safe Sync simple write allow status mutation.
rows.platform_representation: Connector-owned lifecycle projection into trusted export execution.
rows.connector_read_seam: Stock GET only on current base.
rows.result_or_blocker: Trusted simple Safe Sync write now covers status for simple Products; configurable and real-target proof remain pending.

rows.external_write_contract: Magento stock save and Safe Sync simple write allow visibility mutation.
rows.platform_representation: Magento visibility semantics represented inside export execution.
rows.connector_read_seam: Stock GET only on current base.
rows.result_or_blocker: Trusted write primitive exists, but current runtime gate still blocks before any consequential write.

rows.external_write_contract: Magento stock save and Safe Sync simple write allow base price mutation.
rows.platform_representation: Resolved price value entering export execution, not a Product column owner decision.
rows.connector_read_seam: Stock GET only on current base.
rows.result_or_blocker: Trusted READ does not expose price and Receive pricing remains unimplemented.

rows.external_read_contract: Stock product GET plus attribute metadata discovery expose scalar custom attributes present on the target installation.
rows.external_write_contract: Magento stock save supports custom_attributes; current Safe Sync mapped_attributes support is scalar-string only.
rows.platform_representation: FieldDefinition plus FieldBinding plus ProductFieldValue or VariantFieldValue.
rows.connector_read_seam: Adobe discovery capability plus stock GET candidate read.
rows.connector_write_seam: AdobeSafeSyncClient::writeSimpleProduct() mapped_attributes for scalar strings only.
rows.installation_condition: Must be discovered from the actual target installation and attribute set; no repository fixture is a universal schema.
rows.result_or_blocker: Current matrix intentionally does not claim a universal custom-attribute field list.

rows.external_read_contract: Stock product GET plus attribute metadata/options discovery expose select values and option ids.
rows.external_write_contract: Magento stock save supports target option ids; Safe Sync mapped_attributes can carry one mapped scalar option value.
rows.platform_representation: Governed select field binding plus option mapping.
rows.connector_read_seam: Adobe discovery capability plus stock GET candidate read.
rows.connector_write_seam: AdobeSafeSyncClient::writeSimpleProduct() mapped_attributes for single scalar option values only.
rows.installation_condition: Options and labels depend on the actual target installation and store context.
rows.result_or_blocker: Option mapping remains target-dependent and only partially represented by current trusted write seam.

rows.external_read_contract: Stock product GET plus attribute metadata/options discovery expose multiselect values and option ids.
rows.external_write_contract: Magento supports multiselect writes, but current connector trusted write seam does not.
rows.platform_representation: Governed multi_select field binding plus option mapping.
rows.connector_read_seam: Adobe discovery capability plus stock GET candidate read.
rows.connector_write_seam: UNSUPPORTED in current trusted write seam.
rows.installation_condition: Requires target-specific option inventory and governed serialization rules.
rows.result_or_blocker: Current mapped_attributes contract is scalar only and cannot safely represent multiselect writes.

rows.external_read_contract: Magento exposes media through product and media endpoints.
rows.external_write_contract: Magento supports media create, update, delete, and store-view inheritance control.
rows.platform_representation: Media-domain owned gallery and roles, not scalar Product field mutation.
rows.connector_read_seam: Stock GET candidate read only on current base.
rows.connector_write_seam: UNSUPPORTED in current Safe Sync simple product write.
rows.result_or_blocker: Current 2.4.9 media inheritance behavior was refreshed, but current connector has no entity-bound Safe Sync media contract.

rows.magento_surface: configurable products options endpoints and payload structures
rows.external_read_contract: Magento configurable option APIs expose parent dimension structures.
rows.external_write_contract: Magento configurable option APIs mutate parent dimension structures.
rows.platform_domain_owner: Product and ProductVariant relation plus mapped dimension fields
rows.platform_representation: Connector execution structures for configurable dimensions.
rows.connector_read_seam: Existing stock configurable GET seam family already exists in the request factory and remote state client.
rows.connector_write_seam: UNSUPPORTED in current Safe Sync simple write primitive.
rows.result_or_blocker: Current trusted write primitive is simple-product only and does not cover configurable option mutation.

rows.external_read_contract: Magento configurable child APIs expose parent-child SKU relations.
rows.external_write_contract: Magento configurable child APIs mutate child relations.
rows.platform_representation: Trusted ProductVariant relation with external links per entity.
rows.connector_read_seam: Existing stock configurable child GET seam family already exists.
rows.connector_write_seam: UNSUPPORTED in current Safe Sync simple write primitive.
rows.result_or_blocker: Current connector lacks a trusted entity-bound configurable relation write seam.

rows.magento_surface: category relation APIs and product extension attributes
rows.external_read_contract: Magento exposes category links through product and category APIs.
rows.external_write_contract: Magento category relation APIs mutate assignments.
rows.platform_representation: Product-category relation owned by Category domain.
rows.connector_read_seam: No current dedicated connector read seam.
rows.connector_write_seam: No current dedicated connector write seam.
rows.result_or_blocker: No current relation mapping or execution path exists for category receive or trusted write.

rows.external_field_or_capability: Tier pricing and special pricing capability
rows.external_read_contract: Magento exposes tier and advanced pricing through dedicated APIs and product payload structures.
rows.external_write_contract: Magento mutates advanced pricing through dedicated APIs.
rows.platform_representation: PriceListItem and related pricing records, not one scalar Product field.
rows.result_or_blocker: Current connector only carries one base price value through the Safe Sync simple write primitive.

rows.external_field_or_capability: MSI inventory and source items capability
rows.magento_surface: inventory REST APIs and source item contracts
rows.external_read_contract: Magento inventory APIs expose source items and related availability inputs outside stock Product fields.
rows.external_write_contract: Magento inventory APIs mutate source items outside stock Product fields.
rows.platform_representation: InventoryRecord and AvailabilityResolver, never Product column semantics.
rows.connector_read_seam: No current Product V1 connector seam.
rows.connector_write_seam: No current Product V1 connector seam.
rows.installation_condition: Inventory capability depends on target MSI configuration and remains outside Product field mapping.
rows.result_or_blocker: Adobe REST inventory surface was refreshed, but one exact raw MSI source-path proof remained unavailable in current tooling, so the row stays explicitly bounded.

rows.external_read_contract: Magento may expose module-defined nested structures in product payloads.
rows.external_write_contract: Module-defined service contracts vary by owning domain.
rows.platform_domain_owner: Owning domain must be classified before mapping
rows.platform_representation: No generic platform field binding is allowed.
rows.installation_condition: Generated structures vary with enabled modules and target service contracts.
rows.result_or_blocker: No generic passthrough is permitted; each nested structure must first be classified to an owner.

rows.external_read_contract: Magento exposes target product attribute metadata inventory and options.
rows.platform_representation: Canonical schema discovery snapshot feeding mapping preparation.
rows.result_or_blocker: Current discovery seam exists, but the later real target inventory still must expand installation-dependent rows one field at a time.

rows.magento_surface: Attribute metadata rows with null frontend_input
rows.external_read_contract: Discovery sees these rows and applies a narrow skip rule.
rows.platform_representation: Fail-closed skip behavior for narrow system-only cases.
rows.connector_read_seam: Existing Adobe discovery normalization and service-only eligibility rule.
rows.result_or_blocker: Current null-frontend-input skip logic is intentionally narrow and must not be generalized without new evidence.
